profile.subtitleJa: 出エジプトの記憶に現れる国
profile.summaryJa: 士師記2:1では、主の使いがイスラエルの人々をエジプトから導き出したことを回顧する。

facts.textJa: イスラエルの人々は主を捨て、エジプトから導き出した主を忘れたと記される。
預言者は主がイスラエルをエジプトから導き出し、圧迫者から救ったことを告げる。
ギデオンは、先祖がエジプトから導き出されたと聞いたのに、今は主に見捨てられたと問う。
エフタは、イスラエルがエジプトから出た後に荒野を通り、アルノンへ来た経緯を述べる。
エフタの説明では、イスラエルはエジプトから出て荒野を進み、カデシュへ来た。
語り手は、イスラエルの人々がエジプトから出た後に主へ背いたことを回顧する。

profile.modernLocationJa: ナイル川流域を中心とする古代国名。現代国家エジプトの領域や国境とは同一視しない。
profile.historicalRoleJa: 出エジプトの記憶を語る国名として初出する。
profile.locationNoteJa: 古代の地理的広がりは現代国家の境界と同じではありません。候補表示は地域の目安です。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The LORD’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said, “I brought you out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore to give your fathers. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you.

They abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed themselves down to them; and they provoked the LORD to anger.
The LORD sent a prophet to the children of Israel; and he said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you out of the house of bondage.

Gideon said to him, “Oh, my lord, if the LORD is with us, why then has all this happened to us? Where are all his wondrous works which our fathers told us of, saying, ‘Didn’t the LORD bring us up from Egypt?’ But now the LORD has cast us off, and delivered us into the hand of Midian.”

The king of the children of Ammon answered the messengers of Jephthah, “Because Israel took away my land when he came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and to the Jordan. Now therefore restore that territory again peaceably.”
but when they came up from Egypt, and Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh,

It was so, that all who saw it said, “Such a deed has not been done or seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt to this day! Consider it, take counsel, and speak.”
